name: command_failed_diag
description: A tool fails with a structured command_failed summary (exit code + stderr tail). The recorded second step CITES the exit code and the failing test name — a citation that is only possible if the diagnostics actually reached the model.

steps.note: model reacts to the concrete diagnostics, not a generic failure

deltas.content: The run failed with command_failed exit=1: TestFoo asserts x != y. I would fix the assertion in TestFoo before retrying.
